entries.topic: Escape-path timeout is a Kara death
originals: Is the escape-path timeout a Kara death?
Alice's fate in the two shotgun endings, and whether LUTHER BROUGHT ALICE TO ZLAKTO shows Kara killed (second half)
entries.answer: Yes. Kara page: 'If Kara escapes the memory machine or recovers her memory, but fails to find Alice in time, Zlatko will kill her with a shotgun and Luther will bring Alice to him' and 'Zlatko will find and destroy her, ending her storyline'; the string table files Zlatko's 'I should've dismantled you from the start… Time to rectify that mistake…' under X0502K.BIGROOM.GAMEOVER. The chart's no-entry icon is used on all four failure endings, including both shotgun deaths, so it does not argue against a death
entries.source: /tmp/flowcharts/ch17/w_kara.txt lines 104 and 259; dbt/keys.txt lines 252-253; research note §1 icon key
